text.p: General Obligation Refunding and Improvement Bonds,
Notice is hereby given that the Mayor of the City of Jackson, Tennessee (the ity''

sealed bids only for the purchase of the Municipality's $35,730,000* General Obligation Refunding and Improvement Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds''), on an all or none basis, until 11:00 o'clock, a.m., C.D.T., on

at the offices of the Mayor, Jackson, Tennessee. The sale may be postponed upon notice given by Munifacts News Wire not less than twenty-four hours prior to the time bids are to be received. If the postponement occurs, the sale will be held at the time and date announced via Munifacts News Wire at least forty-eight hours before the sale. The Bonds shall be sold at a rate or rates not exceeding seven percent (7%) per annum. The Bonds will be dated August 1, 1997, and will mature on March 1 in the years 1998 through 2017, inclusive. No bid will be considered for less than ninety-nine percent (99%) of par and accrued interest on the Bonds. The Bonds will be awarded on the sale date by the Mayor of the Municipality.

The Bonds maturing March 1, 2006 and thereafter are callable on March 1, 2005 and thereafter as provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The printed Bonds and approving opinion of Bass, Berry & Sims PLC, Nashville, Tennessee will be furnished at the expense of the Municipality. Additional information, including the Official Statement and Detailed Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the undersigned at Jackson City Hall, Jackson, Tennessee 38302 or from First Tennessee Bank National Association, Attn: Jim Vogel, 845 Crossover Lane, Suite 150, Memphis, Tennessee 38117,
* Preliminary, subject to change, as set
forth in the Detailed Notice of Sale.
